name: One ~Sekai de Tada Hitori Boku no Kimi wa Hitori Dake~
original_name: one ～世界でただひとり ぼくのきみはひとりだけ～
source:
Main character has a habit of oversleeping, so it's difficult for him to find a work for a long time. He is invited to work as a host. The problem is that there is no star host in the enterprise, and main character is pushed to take this position... 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公有睡过头的习惯，因此很难长期维持一份工作。他受邀成为牛郎，可问题在于这家店没有头牌，于是主人公被推上了这个位置…

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
